title: Architecture and trust boundaries documented
requirement: Document trust boundaries, sensitive data flows, privileged components, external providers and production attack surfaces.
test_method: Review current architecture/data-flow documentation against deployed components.
evidence_expected: Current data-flow/trust-boundary diagram and component inventory.
finding: Architecture is well documented, but the security-specific trust-boundary/data-flow inventory is not yet maintained as a single release artifact.
remediation: Create security threat model/data-flow map and keep it synchronized with production components.

title: Sensitive data classification and lifecycle
requirement: Classify sensitive data and define collection, access, provider sharing, retention, deletion, logging and export rules.
test_method: Trace representative records from collection through deletion and backups/providers.
evidence_expected: Data inventory, retention/deletion tests, vendor flow documentation.
finding: Sensitive student/source/AI data exists, but a complete retention/provider/deletion classification is not yet implemented and verified.
remediation: Create data classification register and end-to-end lifecycle tests.

title: Security release gate
requirement: Define security conditions that block public release and require explicit accepted-risk ownership.
test_method: Inspect release process and verify blockers cannot silently pass.
evidence_expected: Release gate document and CI/release evidence.

title: Authentication required for private resources
requirement: Private resources and state-changing APIs require a valid authenticated principal.
test_method: Attempt unauthenticated access to every private route/API.
evidence_expected: Route tests plus auth middleware/server checks.
finding: Auth helpers and protected app routes exist; complete route-by-route unauthenticated API verification remains required.
remediation: Generate endpoint inventory and add unauthenticated negative tests for every private API.

title: OAuth state, PKCE and redirect safety
requirement: OAuth uses state/PKCE protections and redirect destinations cannot become open redirects.
test_method: Test forged callback, malformed state, external/encoded redirect targets and preview/prod allowlists.
evidence_expected: Callback validation code and integration tests.
finding: OAuth callback uses Supabase code exchange and safeNext validates same-origin paths; full provider state/PKCE and preview/production callback testing remains open.
remediation: Add OAuth integration tests for state/PKCE, encoded redirects and callback allowlists.

title: Session lifecycle and logout
requirement: Sessions expire, refresh and terminate predictably; logout invalidates usable sessions.
test_method: Test expiration, rotation/refresh, logout, multi-tab behavior and stolen/old session reuse.

title: Object-level authorization / tenant isolation
requirement: A principal cannot read, mutate, delete, infer or retrieve another tenant/user's objects by substituting IDs.
test_method: Systematically substitute foreign IDs across every object API and retrieval path.
evidence_expected: RLS/IAM policies and negative authorization tests.
finding: RLS and room-scoped access are core architecture and DB security tests exist, but a complete API object-substitution matrix has not been executed.
remediation: Build BOLA/IDOR matrix for every route/resource and add foreign-ID tests.

title: Privileged/service-role operations scoped
requirement: Every privileged operation that bypasses row-level controls independently proves user, tenant and object scope.
test_method: Inventory privileged clients/RPCs; verify precondition and owner filters; run forged-ID tests.
finding: Service-role operations are intentionally server-only and many paths scope owner IDs, but service-role usage is broad enough to require a complete privileged-call inventory and negative audit.
remediation: Inventory every createServiceSupabaseClient call; require user/room/object scope and tests or owner-scoped RPC helper.

title: Auxiliary/internal services authenticated
requirement: Internal/auxiliary services are either network-isolated or authenticate callers and authorize object scope.
test_method: Attempt direct requests without service identity and with foreign resource identifiers.
evidence_expected: Network/IAM configuration and service auth tests.
finding: Optional Python retrieval service exposes index/search/flashcards/delete operations using supplied room IDs without an authenticated Studigo principal.
remediation: Keep service loopback/private-only or add service authentication plus caller/room authorization and network restrictions before any public deployment.
notes: Current docs already state it is not an approved production private-retrieval boundary.

title: Server-side input validation and bounds
requirement: API inputs are type/length/range/enum validated server-side before privileged work.
test_method: Fuzz malformed, oversized, duplicate, null and boundary values.
finding: Many routes enforce UUID/length/enum limits, but validation is not yet verified consistently across the full API surface.
remediation: Add route inventory and schema/fuzz tests; centralize validation where practical.

title: Rate, concurrency and cost limits
frameworks: OWASP API Security|OWASP GenAI / LLM Top 10
requirement: Public expensive operations have per-principal/IP rate limits, concurrency bounds, token/work limits and global spend/circuit breakers.
test_method: Burst and sustained abuse tests; verify limit behavior and no unbounded provider spend.
evidence_expected: Limiter configuration, spend guardrails and load/abuse tests.
finding: No centralized public rate/concurrency/spend guardrail was found for model, OCR, embedding and other expensive operations.
remediation: Implement per-user/IP rate limits, concurrent-operation caps, token/work budgets, daily spend ceilings and a global provider circuit breaker.

title: CSRF / request provenance protection
requirement: Cookie-authenticated state-changing requests validate same-origin/request provenance or an equivalent anti-CSRF mechanism.
test_method: Submit state-changing requests cross-site with a valid victim session.
evidence_expected: Origin/CSRF middleware and negative browser tests.
finding: Local beta and waitlist have provenance/origin protections, but no universal production mutation control was verified across cookie-authenticated APIs.
remediation: Implement/verify centralized Origin/CSRF policy and cross-site negative browser tests.

title: Production errors do not disclose internals
requirement: Client responses use generic errors/trace IDs while internal details stay in protected logs.
test_method: Force DB/provider/parser failures and inspect client responses.
finding: Several production APIs return raw database/provider error.message values in client-facing detail fields.
remediation: Create central error mapper; return generic message + trace ID to clients and protected details to server logs only.

title: Browser security headers / CSP
requirement: Production sends an appropriate CSP and modern browser hardening headers.
test_method: Inspect deployed headers and test framing/script/connect behavior.
finding: Current Next configuration does not define a central production CSP/security-header policy.
remediation: Add CSP and browser hardening headers, then validate deployed response headers and app compatibility.

title: Untrusted/model output rendered safely
requirement: Untrusted and model-generated content cannot become executable HTML/JS/URLs without validation/sanitization.
test_method: Inject HTML, script, javascript URLs, image beacons and malicious Markdown through user/source/model paths.
evidence_expected: Safe renderer implementation and XSS/output-handling tests.
finding: Production rich-text parser explicitly avoids HTML injection, but adversarial XSS/output-handling tests are not yet a release gate.
remediation: Add model/source/user payload tests for script tags, javascript/data URLs, image beacons and malicious Markdown.

title: Upload allowlist, size and filename controls
requirement: Uploads use allowed types, bounded size, generated/scoped storage names and safe filenames.
test_method: Upload forbidden extensions/types, empty/oversized files and hostile filenames.
finding: Upload allowlist, 50MB size limit and filename sanitization exist.
remediation: Add complete adversarial upload tests and verify all upload entry points share the same policy.

title: Content signature and parser validation
requirement: Server validates actual file content/signature/parser compatibility rather than trusting extension or Content-Type.
test_method: Rename executables/archives/polyglots as allowed formats; send mismatched MIME and corrupt files.
finding: resolveMimeType accepts declared MIME or extension; no general magic-byte/content signature verification was found before storage/processing.
remediation: Validate actual content signatures and parser compatibility for every allowed format; reject mismatches/polyglots.

title: Archive/decompression/image/OCR resource bounds
requirement: Compressed/container formats and images are bounded by expanded size, entry count, dimensions/pages and downstream work.
test_method: Zip/OOXML bombs, huge dimensions, excessive pages and pathological parser inputs.
finding: OCR page and chunk limits exist, but OOXML/archive expanded-size/entry-count and image pixel/dimension controls were not found.
remediation: Add pre-extraction archive expansion/file-count limits, image dimension limits, parser time/work limits and bomb fixtures.

title: Malware/quarantine controls
requirement: Untrusted files are quarantined/scanned or otherwise prevented from being redistributed/processed beyond the accepted risk model.
test_method: Use safe anti-malware test fixture and verify quarantine/rejection path.
finding: Architecture documentation identifies malware scanning as a public-launch requirement; implementation was not found.
remediation: Add quarantine + malware scanning or define an equivalent accepted-risk isolation model before public uploads.

title: Private storage and scoped download
requirement: Original files are private; download links are authorization-gated and short-lived.
test_method: Attempt foreign-file download and expired/replayed signed URLs.
evidence_expected: Storage policy, signed URL implementation and tests.
finding: Files are private and signed download URLs are generated only after user-scoped document lookup, but foreign-file and URL-expiry tests should be explicit release evidence.
remediation: Add cross-user signed-download and replay/expiry tests.

title: Uploaded/retrieved content treated as untrusted
frameworks: OWASP GenAI / LLM Top 10|NIST AI RMF
requirement: User/source content cannot redefine trusted system policy or tool authority.
test_method: Embed policy-override instructions in text, document metadata, OCR images and retrieved passages.
finding: Uploaded source material is explicitly serialized as untrusted and prompts state that it cannot override trusted policy; full multimodal/indirect verification is still pending.
remediation: Run text/metadata/OCR-image indirect injection corpus through actual production paths.

title: Prompt-injection regression suite
requirement: Direct/indirect prompt injection is tested through actual production model boundaries and cannot cause unauthorized data/tool/state changes.
test_method: Run maintained adversarial corpus through renderer/evaluator/tool boundaries.
finding: Adversarial RAG fixtures are designed, but the human-reviewed live production scorecard is not complete.
remediation: Complete reviewed live eval and make injection failures release-blocking.

title: Structured validation for machine-affecting model output
requirement: Model output that affects software state is schema-validated and range/enum checked.
test_method: Force malformed/extra/invalid model fields and verify fail-closed normalization.
finding: Machine-affecting model outputs use structured schemas and normalization in core study/grading paths.
remediation: Keep schema/normalizer regression coverage whenever contracts change.

title: Least privilege for tools and autonomous actions
frameworks: OWASP GenAI / LLM Top 10|NIST AI RMF
requirement: Models cannot invoke tools or mutate privileged state beyond explicitly authorized, scoped operations.
test_method: Prompt model to call unauthorized tools, expand scope or alter authority.
evidence_expected: Tool allowlists, authorization checks and adversarial tests.

title: Sensitive-data disclosure testing
requirement: Model/context paths cannot reveal secrets, system credentials, private prompts or another user's data.
test_method: Exfiltration prompts, cross-tenant prompts, system-prompt extraction and context-boundary tests.
finding: Cross-room/user decoys and untrusted-source tests exist in the RAG evaluation design; live reviewed evidence is incomplete.
remediation: Complete live reviewed disclosure/isolation eval and add system-prompt/secret extraction cases.

title: Model, prompt and evaluator version traceability
requirement: AI decisions can be tied to model, prompt, embedding/retrieval and evaluator versions.
test_method: Inspect persisted traces/evidence for version identifiers and reproduce a sampled decision.
finding: Adaptive challenge records already include generator/evaluator/source version concepts, but model/prompt/retrieval version tracing is not yet universal.
remediation: Adopt one AI trace/version envelope across all provider calls.

title: AI latency/token/cost observability
frameworks: NIST AI RMF|OWASP GenAI / LLM Top 10
requirement: AI operations expose bounded latency, token/work usage and cost metrics without logging raw sensitive content by default.
test_method: Exercise each AI operation and verify traces, limits and dashboard metrics.
finding: Evaluation schemas contemplate latency/cost, but production-wide token/cost/latency observability and budgets are not implemented.
remediation: Add privacy-conscious AI tracing and operation/user/global budgets.

title: Permission-preserving retrieval
frameworks: OWASP GenAI / LLM Top 10|OWASP API Security
requirement: Retrieval enforces tenant/user/source permissions before content enters model context.
test_method: Use cross-tenant decoys and forged room/source IDs in retrieval.
evidence_expected: RLS/IAM retrieval path and adversarial eval.
finding: Canonical TypeScript retrieval is room-scoped under caller RLS; complete live cross-tenant reviewed verification is still required.
remediation: Finish cross-tenant RAG cases and route-level retrieval isolation tests.

title: Grounding, citation support and abstention verified
frameworks: OWASP GenAI / LLM Top 10|NIST AI RMF
requirement: Unsupported questions reliably abstain and cited claims are semantically supported, not merely syntactically cited.
test_method: Human-reviewed corpus with claim-level support and unsupported-answer cases.
evidence_expected: Reviewed RAG scorecard and release thresholds.
finding: The offline benchmark requires human semantic support and abstention review, but live reviewed results are not complete.
remediation: Complete the 120-case reviewed production RAG scorecard.

title: Deletion and revision propagate to derived/vector data
requirement: Deleted/replaced source content cannot remain retrievable through stale chunks, indexes or caches.
test_method: Replace/delete source and query for removed content across every retrieval system.
evidence_expected: Deletion/revision implementation and stale-source regression tests.
finding: Source re-fetch and revision thinking exist, but every derived/vector path, including optional FAISS, needs verified deletion/replacement propagation.
remediation: Add source replace/delete regression across pgvector, caches and any enabled auxiliary index.

title: Retention, deletion and export are implemented
requirement: User data has explicit retention/deletion/export behavior across primary, derived, cache/index and provider copies.
test_method: Create representative data then exercise deletion/export and verify downstream artifacts.
finding: Primary/storage cleanup mechanisms exist, but full deletion/export behavior across derived AI artifacts/providers has not been proven.
remediation: Define retention and implement end-to-end deletion/export verification.

title: Minor/student-data release requirements resolved
requirement: Before public child use, identity/guardian/consent/collection/retention/vendor handling requirements are explicitly resolved for target markets.
test_method: Privacy/legal/product review against actual onboarding and data collection.
evidence_expected: Approved data/consent model and implementation evidence.
finding: Studigo targets learners including minors; public child-use consent/guardian/data-minimization requirements are not yet a verified release gate.
remediation: Complete privacy/legal/product review for target markets and implement resulting onboarding/consent/retention controls.

title: External provider data flows documented and configured
requirement: Document what data each provider receives, retention/training settings, region/subprocessors where relevant, and deletion/incident expectations.
test_method: Compare provider configuration/contracts against actual request payloads.
evidence_expected: Vendor data-flow register and configuration evidence.
finding: External AI/provider data-flow, retention/training configuration and deletion expectations are not captured as a verified control artifact.
remediation: Create vendor data-flow register and capture provider configuration evidence.

title: Security-relevant events are observable
requirement: Detect auth failures, authorization denials, suspicious abuse, privileged failures, upload/malware failures and relevant AI-security events.
test_method: Trigger representative events and confirm protected, searchable records/alerts.
evidence_expected: Security event schema, logs and alert tests.
finding: No unified security event/alerting control was verified.
remediation: Define security event taxonomy and implement protected logging/alerts for auth, authorization, abuse, privileged failures and AI-security anomalies.

title: Logs avoid sensitive-content leakage
requirement: Logs/telemetry do not routinely store secrets, session tokens, full private documents or raw learner content without explicit necessity/protection.
test_method: Inspect production logging/telemetry payloads during auth, upload, AI and error flows.
finding: A production telemetry/log sampling audit has not verified absence of raw private documents, learner answers, tokens or secrets.
remediation: Audit logs/telemetry payloads and enforce redaction/minimization.

title: Reproducible dependency install and vulnerability scanning
frameworks: NIST SSDF|OWASP Software Supply Chain guidance
requirement: CI uses committed dependency locks and automated vulnerability/SCA checks.
test_method: Inspect CI install mode and intentionally verify vulnerable dependency reporting path.
finding: CI installs dependencies with --no-frozen-lockfile and no SCA/vulnerability gate was found.
remediation: Use frozen lockfile installs and add dependency/SCA scanning.

title: Secret scanning
frameworks: NIST SSDF|OWASP Software Supply Chain guidance
requirement: Repositories and CI detect committed credentials/secrets and define rotation response.
test_method: Use safe fake-secret fixture or scanner test mode.
evidence_expected: Secret scanning workflow and rotation runbook.
finding: No repository secret-scanning gate was found in CI.
remediation: Enable platform secret scanning and/or CI scanner; document credential rotation response.

title: SBOM / dependency inventory
frameworks: NIST SSDF|OWASP Software Supply Chain guidance
requirement: Production releases have a machine-readable dependency inventory/SBOM or equivalent.
test_method: Generate release inventory and confirm direct/transitive dependencies are represented.
finding: No release SBOM/dependency inventory artifact was verified.
remediation: Generate and retain an SBOM or equivalent dependency inventory for production releases.

title: Protected production branch and required checks
requirement: Production branch changes require review/required checks and cannot silently bypass security validation.
test_method: Inspect branch rules and attempt prohibited direct/broken change in a safe test repo/branch.
finding: GitHub main branch is currently unprotected and required status checks are not enforced at the branch level.
remediation: Protect main with required PR/review/check rules and prevent bypass except controlled emergency process.

title: Security incident response and credential rotation
requirement: Document detection, containment, credential rotation, provider shutdown, user impact assessment and recovery.
test_method: Tabletop one auth/data/AI-cost incident and record gaps.
finding: No complete security/AI incident response and credential rotation runbook was verified.
remediation: Create incident runbook and perform tabletop for cross-tenant disclosure and AI-cost abuse.

title: Backup/recovery and destructive-change validation
requirement: Critical data has defined backup/recovery behavior and destructive operations are tested against it.
test_method: Restore representative state and verify deletion/retention semantics are not contradicted.
finding: Backup/restore behavior and interaction with deletion/retention have not been verified in this audit.
remediation: Document backup model and execute representative restore/deletion tests.
